# semaphore_ex_workflow_trigger_signing_promote (Action)

Explicitly promotes a staged webhook signing key using the supplied revision. It never returns secret material.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_revision` (Number)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `trigger_id` (Number)
- `workflow_id` (Number)
